§ 01 · The Program

A complete
curriculum.

From entry-level B1 to advanced C1 professional, every module is grounded in real-world agricultural scenarios — from precision farming and crop protection to supply-chain logistics, from soil science to agribusiness strategy. Built for use inside agribusiness enterprises, cooperatives, agricultural ministries, and international agribusiness MBA programs.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Agriculture Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international agriculture professionals. Verdant reflects his vision: language learning as strategic capability — a multiplier of careers, partnerships, and entire food systems.

Designed for the farm managers, agronomists, agribusiness executives, and supply-chain leaders reshaping global food production — Verdant is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to lead in the most essential, rapidly transforming industry of our time.
